name: Spiritual Authority
overview: Scripture reveals that spiritual authority originates from Christ, who holds all power in heaven and on earth, granting His followers authority over demonic forces and sickness, as seen when He empowered the twelve disciples (Matthew 28:18; Luke 9:1). Believers exercise this authority through faith in His name, enabling them to cast out devils and speak with new tongues (Mark 16:17). Furthermore, Jesus entrusted His church with binding and loosing on earth, a spiritual authority that is recognized in heaven (Matthew 18:18), underscoring the believer’s role in spiritual warfare and divine victory over enemies (Deuteronomy 28:7).
